# Precision Parking 3D / 極限停車場：都市挑戰

> Slow down. Find your angle. Make every space count.

在都市停車場裡，慢一點，停得更漂亮。

- iOS 16.0+ · v1.0.2 · 2026-10-12 · 159.8 MB
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816430472?pt=102436810&ct=llms_precisionparking3d&mt=8)
- [Support](https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/support.html)

## FAQ

### Is there a phone game for practising parking?
Precision Parking 3D has three tutorial levels and 40 levels in five chapters to practise steering, pedals and gears, playable offline.

### 有沒有練習停車的手機遊戲？
極限停車場：都市挑戰有三個教學關卡和五章 40 關，練習轉向、踏板與換檔，可離線遊玩。

### Can Precision Parking 3D be played offline?
All core levels work offline, and progress and achievements stay on your device; advertising and privacy services need a connection.

### 極限停車場可以離線玩嗎？
所有核心關卡都可以離線遊玩，進度與成就保存在裝置上；廣告與隱私服務需要網路。

### Is there a parking game with a steering wheel control?
Precision Parking 3D lets you choose left/right buttons, sliding steering or a rotating wheel, and switch between third-person and overhead views; each level has three objectives: park, avoid collisions and an extra challenge.

### 有沒有可以用方向盤操作的停車遊戲？
極限停車場可以選擇左右按鈕、滑動轉向或旋轉方向盤，並切換第三人稱與俯視視角；每關有完成停車、零碰撞與額外挑戰三個目標。
